documentation.author: agent
documentation.basis: Approved neutral text, unchanged gold values and the v1 extraction contract. Explanatory notes added at user request after case-level approval; no new human field review is claimed.

headers.note: Retain the value labeled as the PO identifier as text, including punctuation and leading zeros; do not reinterpret it as a date.
The labeled date is already in YYYY-MM-DD format; retain it. This is the PO issue date, distinct from delivery or service dates.
No explicit ship-to block appears in the neutral input. Do not reuse the buyer name as a delivery address.
No selected payment terms appear in the neutral input. Do not assume a default credit period.
No explicit selected order currency appears in the neutral input. Do not infer currency from language, geography or unit price.
No explicit net product total for this PO appears in the neutral input. Do not calculate a replacement total from quantity and unit price.

lines.evidence: ORDER!C10 Article code: 54629115 | D10 Description: Finishing additive PC-75 200 kg drum | E10 Quantity: 79 | F10 UOM: GAL | A10 Line no.: 1 | B10 Buyer product code: 024-86718 | G10 Delivery date: 2026-08-16

fields.note: Retain the explicitly printed line number as text, including leading zeros. Do not renumber the selected lines.
Use the explicitly labeled buyer product code, preserving punctuation and leading zeros. The separate article/supplier code is not the buyer code.

fields.evidence: D10 Description: Finishing additive PC-75 200 kg drum

fields.note: Use the positive ordered quantity, not a number or package size embedded in the generated product description.
GAL denotes gallons. The v1 enum has no gallon category, so use OTHER. No US/imperial conversion is established.
No unit price for the ordered quantity's UOM appears in the prepared row. Do not derive a price from package size, a catalog price or a different pricing unit.
The labeled date is already in YYYY-MM-DD format; retain it. The date is explicitly attached to this ordered row.

lineSelection.note: Select every row with an explicit positive ordered quantity, preserving input order. Exclude catalog rows with [blank] ordered quantity.
